messages:
maya: created RC rc-2026-03-23-01 and uploaded artifacts (pin: v2.14.3-candidate). release notes draft: https://docs.internal/redwood/releases/rc-2026-03-23 :spiral_note_pad: please ack and call out any blocking regressions.
sam: quick q — does this include the user-metadata migration? would like to avoid overlap with the analytics migration window.
maya: yep, includes migration script `20260323_user_meta.sql`. plan is to run migration during canary step, controlled by flag `user_meta.migrate=true`.
opsbot: deploy schedule created: canary start 2026-03-23T15:30Z; canary percent=5; window=20m. deploy run id=deploy_9876.
liam: recommend micro-canary to us-west only for first 10m then expand to global 5% if no regressions. also KV warmup for embed-service before traffic shift.
zara: KV warmup acked. I'll run `kv-warm --service embed-service --keys 100k` 10m before canary.
oncall-jen: holding for db-lock window — our DB team flagged a migration lock at 15:45Z in eu-west. prefer to shift canary +20m to avoid conflicts.
andre: +1 on shifting. also request a rollback playbook note in thread (steps and owner).
maya: OK shifting canary start to 15:50Z. updated deploy schedule. rollback owner: @andre. rollback steps added to release notes quick section:
```
# rollback playbook
1) run `deploy rollback --run-id deploy_9876`
2) pin traffic to previous artifact `v2.14.2-stable`
3) clear KV caches: `kv-purge --service embed-service`
4) notify #incidents and oncall
```

maya: adding a soft hold until infra and oncall ack :hourglass_flowing_sand:
sam: reviewed release notes, minor wording nit but not blocking. :thumbsup:
liam: infra ack — KV warm and micro-canary plan good. :white_check_mark:
zara: will kick KV warm at 15:40Z and confirm here when done.
oncall-jen: oncall ack for shifted window. I'll be monitoring latency and error-rate dashboards.
deploy-bot: canary scheduled: deploy_9876 queued -> will start at 2026-03-23T15:50Z. Use `deploy status deploy_9876` to watch logs.
maya: final signoff from product required — @sam can you post a short note if product ok with release notes and migration messaging?
sam: product signoff: docs and migration messaging fine. go for canary. :tada:
maya: thanks all — promoting to canary at scheduled time. if we see >1.5x baseline error-rate or p95 latency increase >200ms we'll pause and roll back. monitoring checklist in release notes.
andre: rollback owner standing by. contact via @andre or pager 2 if triggered.
maya: leaving this thread open for live updates during canary. will post promo/rollback outcomes here.
